main.description: A request to borrow an item. Written to the borrower's repo, so it's public.

item.description: AT-URI of the garden.myles.lending.item being requested. Its authority must be the lender's DID, not a handle.

lender.description: DID of the person who owns the item. Must match the authority of item.

message.description: Optional note to the lender. Public, like the rest of the record.
